payload.summary: vitest --reporter=basic does not exist and dies at startup reporting zero failures
payload.detail: Running any vitest invocation with --reporter=basic in this repo fails with 'Error: Failed to load custom Reporter from basic'. Zero tests run, zero failures are reported, and the run is indistinguishable from a clean pass unless the output is read rather than the exit code. Two chats hit this on 2026-09-02 and one would have reported three failing tests as fixed. Consider either a wrapper that rejects unknown reporter names, or a line in docs/testing.md. Observed at fb17db7b1.
